comment: Ring systems at true radii (km from the planet centre, equatorial plane). tau = typical normal optical depth; albedo = effective single-scattering albedo (single-scattering model, tuned so the lit B ring is about as bright as the globe); dust = fraction of forward-scattering dust in the phase function; map = take fine structure from the Celestia radial profile (mean optical depth stays tau). Later rows override earlier ones (gaps). Values marked approximate are representative, not measured at a single radius.

systems.source: NASA NSSDCA Saturnian Rings Fact Sheet (nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/satringfact.html); Cassini Division bounds 117,580-122,170 km per DESIGN P3; profile radii from Celestia solarsys.ssc
